findings.finding: F1: Undisclosed stale terminal artifact with impossible timestamp. research/control/ZCODE-ORCHESTRATION-V3/orchestration/terminal_reconciliation.json declares terminal_verdict ZCODE_ORCHESTRATION_V3_BLOCKED_PLUGIN_TRUST_INSTALL and grades Z3-G5/G6/G7 NOT_RUN / Z3-G8 PARTIAL / G3-G4 live NOT_RUN, with written_at_utc 2026-09-11T02:45:00Z — which postdates every canary completion (store last event 02:38:18Z; p9_recovery_result.json 02:42:47Z G8 PASS). The content is provably pre-canary (it matches the registry row already stale at 01:43:02Z and a 36-test battery without store_flows). Whether mislabeled by a day or forward-stamped, the artifact as frozen contradicts the claim set's terminal narrative and is NOT among the staleness items C8 discloses (it discloses only the registry row and STOP-CAP-1). It must be explicitly superseded/rewritten at close.

F2: Z3-G3/Z3-G4 live halves were never formally re-graded. The only gate matrix entry grading them says PASS_SCHEMA_LEVEL / PASS_SCRIPT_LEVEL with 'live-load NOT_RUN' / 'live-ZCode NOT_RUN'. Live functional evidence does exist in canary artifacts (SessionStart snapshot observed, PostAgent/PreToolUse/Stop hooks firing, 11 MCP tools live in a fresh session, negctl-mcp-v31 refused by the running MCP), but the artifacts themselves phrase G3/G4-live as 'PARTIAL PASS evidence'. C8's 'gates Z3-G0..Z3-G8 are evidenced PASS' is therefore an overclaim for G3/G4 until an artifact records the live grade.

F3: Timestamp integrity defects in frozen evidence. v31_verification.json carries measured_at_utc 02:55:00Z together with store_census_after {INTEGRATED:4, BLOCKED:3} = 7 tasks, which was only true before negctl-mcp-v31 registered at 02:37:30Z and blocked at 02:38:18Z (8 tasks, 4 BLOCKED); the census contradicts the artifact's own stamp. p9_recovery_result.json:38 discloses this as writer clock skew (12-25 min ahead of file mtimes) for v31_verification.json and stop_hook_observation.json — same class as F1 but disclosed. Additionally integration_events.jsonl events carry no date field at all (times only), leaving the P0-P10 build timeline undated and forcing inference to reconcile it with the 2026-09-11 canary timeline.

F4: 'Zero tasks in non-terminal states' is true in plan semantics but false under the store's own machine readout. orchestrator_store.py defines TERMINAL_STATES={'TERMINAL'} and terminal_check() counts INTEGRATED/BLOCKED as non_terminal, so terminal_check() on the current store returns all_terminal=false with 8 non_terminal tasks. The lawful INTEGRATED->TERMINAL / BLOCKED->TERMINAL transitions were never materialized. /lead-close should either materialize TERMINAL statuses or the machine readout will publicly disagree with the terminal claim.

F5: The two live refusal re-verifications (negctl-v31-refusal, negctl-mcp-v31) leave no machine trace — refusals raise HandoffEvidenceRefused without appending any event, so events.jsonl only records the subsequent legitimate report handoff (dispatch_sha correctly equal to base_sha: c4d6d17... and 6cd33db...). The refusal occurrences themselves rest on Lead-authored text (handoff outputs, blocker strings, v31_verification, p9). Mitigation verified by this audit: the guard code exists in both repo and installed cache, and 4 of the 7 store-flow tests exercise exactly these refusals. Consider logging refused publishes as events in a future revision.
